Ministry extends scholarship deadline

By Jane Doe, 2 October 2026

The Ministry of Education announced on Thursday that the deadline for the national scholarship programme has been extended by two weeks after a surge of applications that briefly overloaded the online portal. Students now have until 16 October 2026 to submit their documents.

"We want every eligible student to have a fair chance," a ministry spokesperson said. The scholarship covers full tuition and a monthly stipend of 300 EUR for up to four years of undergraduate study abroad.

Eligible applicants must be citizens under the age of 25, hold a GPA of at least 3.5 and provide proof of admission from one of the partner universities listed on the official partner list.

Further details are available at the programme website.
